stem: A city council in Riverton selected 500 of the city's residents at random and asked whether they support building a new public swimming pool. Of those surveyed, 62% said they support it. What is the largest group to which the results of the survey can appropriately be generalized?

choices.A: All residents of the state that Riverton is in
choices.B: Only the 500 residents who were surveyed
choices.C: Only the residents of Riverton who swim regularly

solution: The 500 residents were selected at random from all residents of Riverton.
A random sample allows its results to be generalized to the population it was drawn from: all residents of Riverton, but no larger group.

explanation.A: Incorrect. The sample came only from Riverton, so it says nothing reliable about the rest of the state.
explanation.B: Incorrect. Because the residents were selected at random, the results can be generalized beyond the 500 people surveyed.
explanation.C: Incorrect. The sample was drawn from all residents, not just swimmers, so it represents all residents.
explanation.D: Correct. A random sample of Riverton residents represents all residents of Riverton.
